first.text: Welcome in. I'm the Sexton, the bot that keeps this hall.
Worth knowing first: I can't hear you, and I can't speak. Voice chat goes right past me.
• Read what you type, here or in the channel, and answer.
• Stream a Twitch, Kick or YouTube link for the room, or play music. Just ask.

returning.text: Welcome back. Still can't hear you or talk back, but type and I'll answer.
